Settings

Peek key

One key that shows every reading in the passage at once, and hides them all again when you press it a second time. Useful when you are reading with the pinyin off and get stuck.

Key click, then press any key

About Pinyin Desk

Paste any Chinese text and it is split into words and annotated with pinyin or zhùyīn. Hide the readings to test yourself, tap a word for its meaning, and save it to a deck that schedules itself.

Keyboard

← →Move between words EnterReveal the reading for the selected word SSave the selected word to your deck EscDeselect PShow or hide every reading at once (the peek key — rebind it in Settings) SpaceShow the answer while reviewing 1 – 4Again · Hard · Good · Easy

Where your data lives

Everything is stored in the browser only. Nothing is uploaded.

Credits

Definitions come from CC-CEDICT, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Word segmentation and the commonness bands use the frequency list from the jieba project (MIT). Both are bundled into this file, which is why it works offline.

Pronunciation uses your device's built-in speech voices, when it has a Chinese one installed.
